name: Industrial Coating and More

hero.title: Scaffolding and insulation
hero.lead: Industrial Coating and More LLC. is a full-service provider of scaffolding, insulation, and specialty surface painting and coating. ICM provides service to businesses in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama.

summary: Industrial Coating and More offers scaffolding, insulation, and surface preparation and coating in and around Dickinson.
